P.name: Death Defied
P.title: Template:Data Karthus/Death Defied
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Death Defied|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Karthus
|skill        = I
|icon         = Death Defied.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon {{tip|death|dying}}, {{ci|Karthus}} enters an {{tip|untargetable}} {{tip|Zombie state|spirit form}} for a few seconds that allows him to continue casting spells at no cost but without being able to move.
|blurb2       = If ''{{ai|Defile|Karthus}}'' has been learned, it will remain toggled on for ''Death Defied's'' entire duration.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Karthus''' enters a '''{{tip|zombie state}}''' for 7 seconds, during which he can cast his abilities at no cost. If ''{{ai|Defile|Karthus}}'' has been learned, it will remain toggled on for ''Death Defied's'' entire duration. ''{{ai|Requiem|Karthus}}'' becomes disabled after 4 seconds of the duration have elapsed.
|description2 = While under this state, '''Karthus''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} as well as prevents all incoming damage, but is also rendered unable to move, declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, use [[summoner spell]]s, and [[Active ability items|activate items]].
|targeting    = Passive
|affects = Self
|notes = 
* ''Death Defied's'' {{tip|untargetability}} does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}.
* '''Karthus''' cannot be {{tip|execute|executed}} by the {{bi|Aspect of the Dragon}} during ''Death Defied''.
* At the start of ''Death Defied'', '''Karthus''' is set to {{sti|health|{{as|1 health}}}}.
** '''Karthus''' can still regenerate his health over the duration, but he will always die at the end of it.
* After ''Death Defied'' ends, the corpse of '''Karthus''' will retain [[unit collision]] despite being dead on the ground.
* '''Karthus' ''' [[health bar|mana bar]] drains over the duration of ''Death Defied'' as an indicator of his time remaining in this state.
{{Zombie state info}}
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Karthus_Original_Death_5.ogg}} ''"I am become death!"''
}}

E.name: Defile
E.title: Template:Data Karthus/Defile
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Defile|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Karthus
|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Karthus}} restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} whenever he kills an enemy.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Karthus''' surrounds himself in a necrotic [[aura]] that continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies, quickly draining his own {{sti|mana}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Karthus''' restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} whenever he kills an enemy.
|leveling     = {{st|Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|10 to 50}}|mana}}}}
|icon2        = Defile.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Karthus''' surrounds himself in a necrotic [[aura]] that deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to all nearby enemies.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|30/4 to 110/4}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Damage Per Second|{{ap|30 to 110}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
|description3 = Toggling ''Defile'' off triggers a final tick of damage. ''Defile'' is toggled off automatically if '''Karthus''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
|description4 = ''Defile cannot be toggled off during {{ai|Death Defied|Karthus}}.''
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 550
|cost         = {{ap|30 to 78}}
|costtype     = Mana per second
|static = {{fd|0.5}}
|cast time = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = aoedot
|spellshield  = False
|notes = 
* Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Defile'' will restore {{tip|mana}} if '''Karthus''' destroys an enemy structure.
* ''Defile'' re-calculates its damage with each tick based on changes in '''Karthus's''' {{as|ability power}} or an increase in the rank of ''Defile'' without the need to toggle it off and on again.
* ''Defile'' will toggle off automatically if '''Karthus''' enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
}}
